desc: Taran Tactical Innovations and CANiK are proud to partner in bringing you the CANiK TTI Combat. Built on a completely new polymer frame designed by Taran Butler, the TTI Combat offers a unique performance package for the CANiK lineup. This sleek design is crafted by the best, for the best, and includes all the features a world champion like Taran Butler needs for success. Both internally and externally, the TTI Combat features aggressive grip texturing, a ported and fluted barrel, the first CANiK compensator, a diamond-cut, flat-faces, 90-degree break trigger.
